what: RSI-Jev v1.0 recipe on Qwen3-0.6B. The curve's first point.
spec_is_published_verbatim: copied from shgao/rsi-jev-v1.0-qwen3.5-2b meta.json; sole deviation eval_batch_size 32->8

deviations.eval_batch_size: theirs=32 -> ours=8. NOT the OOM it was first justified by: that came from a run sharing the card with a 30-step job, and the same run's train_seconds is already discarded for that contention -- one invalidated run cannot yield one number kept and another discarded. Re-measured on an idle card with the v1.0 modules: 32 does not OOM. It does sit at 11,583/12,282 MiB = 94% and take >61 min against 8's 15.6, so 8 is kept for headroom and speed, not for correctness. Evaluation-only. See docs/eval_batch_size_correction.md.

environment._source: rsijev/ from shgao/rsi-jev-v1.0-qwen3.5-2b code/ ; driver from RSI-Jev HEAD

expected.estimate_basis: 2-3 s/step from the 1-step run's own meta.json train_seconds=2 (v1.0 modules, published spec, freeze_base=false); plus ~8 min one-off setup and ~16 min evaluation at eval_batch_size 8

superseded_estimate.why_withdrawn: 23 s/step had no traceable run behind it and is contradicted by the direct 1-step measurement. See docs/arm0_probe_evidence.md.
